controls: Protect account recovery and administrative access.
Use stronger authentication where risk or policy requires it.
Keep secrets out of source code and client bundles.
Protect against injection and cross-site scripting.
Restrict upload types and validate uploaded files.
Apply appropriate rate limits and abuse protections.
Avoid exposing privileged APIs directly to browsers.
Test recovery procedures according to risk.

rules: Controls must be selected based on actual risks and obligations.
A successful automated scan does not prove an application is secure.
Do not claim security certification without appropriate evidence.
Critical unresolved vulnerabilities must follow an approved release-blocking policy.
Production deployment requires appropriate technical authorization.
